top_signals.title: Indonesia Bond Yield Hits Four-Year High as MSCI Risk, Oil Weigh
top_signals.summary: Indonesia’s 10-year government bond yield climbed to a four-year high and the rupiah weakened toward a record low as elevated oil prices and MSCI Inc.’s threat of a stocks downgrade hurt investor sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The Machine Staff
top_signals.summary:
At Nellis Air Force Base last year, an AI system was tasked with building courses of action, a complex operational problem that military planners have spent generations learning to perform. The AI system took less than a minute to complete its task with solutions rated at 97 percent viable and tactically valid (essentially, whether the proposed plan could work given operational constraints such as fuel and force composition). top_signals.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
top_signals.summary: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: AI Is a Choice
top_signals.summary: Alex Imas, Mohamed El-Erian, and James Manyika, leading voices at the intersection of business and technology, argue that realizing AI’s potential requires giving workers, communities, AI labs, infrastructure developers, and big companies a share of the gains. Using insights from game theory, they argue that increased cooperation can make AI work for all.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
